PP_SrcIntro: Like Playnite, each game takes its data first from its own store and then from general databases. The first source that has each piece of data wins, and nothing you edited is ever changed.
PP_SrcStoreText: Epic: the catalog the Epic launcher keeps on your PC (cover, background, description). GOG: GOG's public database. No accounts.
PP_SrcSteamText: Description in your language, genres, year, developer and images, if the game is also on Steam. No account; only the game name is sent.
PP_SrcIgdbText: The database Playnite uses: almost every game, also the ones you add by hand (descriptions in English). It needs two free keys from a Twitch developer account.
PP_SrcAuto: Download data automatically for new games
PP_SrcSecretSaved: (saved; leave it empty to keep it)
PP_SrcHowTo: How to get the keys (free, once): 1) Go to dev.twitch.tv/console and sign in with a Twitch account (it asks to turn on two-step verification). 2) "Register your application": name PhantomPad, OAuth redirect URL http://localhost, category "Application Integration", client type "Confidential". 3) Copy the Client ID, press "New Secret" and copy the Client Secret here. The secret is saved encrypted for your Windows user.
PP_SrcNeedKeys: To use IGDB, write the Client ID and the Client Secret.
PP_SrcBadKeys: the Client ID or the Client Secret is not correct
